audit.whatIsWrong: Almost every ability name on this page is invented. 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' appears in twelve fields; 'E (Severance)' is used for his shield; 'his Recall ultimate' is used for his R; 'Q1 / Q2 (Grim/Restraint)' for his sub-spells. The packet flags it outright: the page never names a single real Hwei ability.
audit.why: The real kit is Signature of the Visionary (P), Subject: Disaster (Q, 10/9/8/7/6 — Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, Molten Fissure), Subject: Serenity (W, 18/17.5/17/16.5/16 — the shield palette), Subject: Torment (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 — Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw) and Spiraling Despair (R, 120/100/80). The CC palette is Torment, not 'Fear'; the shield is Serenity, not 'Severance'; the ultimate is Spiraling Despair, not a 'Recall'.
audit.corrected: Every reachable field re-written with the real names and cooldowns. Also corrected LeBlanc's own Q: the page wrote 'Sigil of Silence/Malice' — it is Sigil of Malice.

audit.why: 52.3% over 2235 games with the chart reading LeBlanc on all seven rows is consistent both with the packet levelChart and with the kit: every Hwei ability is a two-step cast (palette, then paint) and none of them move him, so a dash-in dash-out pattern dictates the exchange at every stage. Chart left untouched.

audit.why: phases[5] is labelled 'First item' and phases[6] is labelled '2+ items'; the sentences under them were reversed.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten so each names its own stage, with the 2+ items row acknowledging that his paints out-range you in a teamfight even while the 1v1 stays yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit and named a non-existent ability.
audit.why: Subject: Torment 12s->10s, Subject: Serenity 18s->16s and Spiraling Despair 120s->80s are the real clocks.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the real palette names and per-rank numbers.

audit.why: Lint findings plus the template sweep.

notes: This matchup was the worst fabricated-name case in the slice: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' does not exist (the CC palette is Subject: Torment, 12s at rank 1), 'E (Severance)' does not exist (the shield palette is Subject: Serenity, 18s), and 'his Recall ultimate' is Spiraling Despair (120/100/80). LeBlanc's own Q was also written 'Sigil of Silence/Malice' — it is Sigil of Malice, which is what the packet's suspectName caught. STILL CARRYING THE FABRICATION, left alone only because of the two-report-entries-per-matchup cap: report[3].t and report[9].t both still say 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. They are simple name swaps and should be scheduled in a follow-up pass. Chart left untouched — all seven rows LeBlanc, matching the packet and 52.3%. whys[5] and whys[6] had their stage labels swapped and are corrected here.
